jobs.title: Director, Data Foundations, Automation & Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Application Deadline:


10/30/2026
Address:


250 Yonge Street
Job Family Group:


Data Analytics \& Reporting
***About the Opportunity:***

*This is an exciting leadership opportunity within Commercial Banking to shape the future of how data powers business decisions across Canada and the U.S.*

*As Director, Data Foundations, Automation \& Information Infrastructure, you will lead a highly technical team responsible for delivering trusted, curated, and scalable data assets that support reporting, analytics, AI, and strategic decision\-making across Commercial Banking. You will oversee data engineering, data operations, information infrastructure, and business\-managed applications while influencing the broader Commercial Banking data strategy.*

*The role combines banking knowledge, technical leadership, people management, and strategic thinking. As the organization continues its journey toward cloud modernization, AI\-enabled automation, Client 360 capabilities, and near real\-time data delivery, this leader will play a critical role in shaping the future state of Commercial Banking's data ecosystem.*

*This opportunity is ideal for a banking\-savvy technology leader who enjoys building high\-performing teams, solving complex data challenges, driving modernization initiatives, and translating business needs into scalable technical solutions.*

**About This Role**
===================

The Director, Data Foundations leads the team responsible for building, managing and continuously improving the curated data that powers Commercial Banking. This includes client, financial, client activity and master data, along with the other key business data sets that reporting, analytics and AI teams across the organization rely on to make decisions.


The Director owns the end\-to\-end data lifecycle, from requirements, data modeling and architecture, through ETL and pipeline development, to the reliable production of trusted data within established service levels. The role partners with business, analytics, AI, Technology and Data Governance partners to ensure data is accurate, well documented and easy to use, and leads the ongoing modernization of data platforms and practices.


The ideal candidate combines deep data management expertise with strong people leadership and a high standard for quality.


**Why This Role Matters**
=========================

Trusted, well\-managed data is the foundation for sound decisions, effective and trusted reporting, and the responsible use of AI. This role directly contributes to:


* Consistent, reliable data that supports executive reporting and business decision\-making
* Curated data assets that allow reporting, analytics and AI teams to focus on insights
* A scalable, modern data ecosystem that keeps pace with evolving business needs
* Strong data quality and control practices aligned to BMO’s data governance standards

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Data Strategy and Architecture**
----------------------------------

* Define and deliver the Data Foundations strategy and roadmap, aligned to business, CDAO and enterprise data priorities
* Design and maintain the data architecture and models for curated data assets, including master and reference data, with long\-term usability and scalability in mind
* Establish and uphold standards for data modeling, naming, metadata, integration and data sharing

**Data Development and Operations**
-----------------------------------

* Lead the design, development and operation of ETL processes and data pipelines
* Ensure recurring data production is accurate, timely and reconciled to authoritative sources, within published service levels
* Monitor data flows, resolve issues promptly and drive root\-cause remediation
* Embed data quality checks, validation and controls throughout the data lifecycle
* Ensure data is handled securely and protected from loss or unauthorized access, in line with legal and company standards

**Modernization and Innovation**
--------------------------------

* Continuously evaluate and adopt technologies, tools and practices that improve the scalability, efficiency and resilience of the data ecosystem
* Partner with Technology on platform strategy, infrastructure and the path to production
* Prepare and structure data to support advanced analytics and AI use cases

**Data Enablement and Partnership**
-----------------------------------

* Manage the intake and prioritization of data requests transparently, with clear service levels
* Promote data literacy and self\-service through documentation, data dictionaries and a community of practice
* Serve as a trusted partner to business, analytics, AI and Technology teams on data definitions, changes and their downstream impacts
* Partner with Data Governance to meet data quality, metadata, lineage and data risk requirements

**Business\-Managed Applications**
----------------------------------

* Oversee a portfolio of business\-managed applications that support key business processes, from intake and design through delivery, enhancement and ongoing support
* Ensure these applications are well controlled and supported, and aligned to BMO technology, data and risk standards

**People Leadership**
---------------------

* Build, develop and lead a high\-performing team of data professionals, working effectively with vendor partners
* Set clear goals and accountability, coach for growth, and foster a culture of ownership, quality and continuous improvement
* Attract, retain and develop top talent, recognizing strong performance and addressing gaps
* Role model BMO values and foster an inclusive culture connected to our purpose
* Take measured risks while protecting the bank by applying our Risk Management Framework in the execution of your role, in line with our Risk Culture and within our approved Risk Appetite, making sound and risk informed decisions that align to business strategy, protect assets, and adhere to applicable poli

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Director
jobs.description:
Overview:
**Create value at TC Transcontinental.** **At TC Transcontinental, we've got it made, and that's because of the expertise of our team.** **We have been driving innovation since 1976\.**  

Founded 50 years ago and 4,000 employees strong, Transcontinental Inc. (TSX: TCL.A TCL.B), known under the TC Transcontinental brand, is a Canadian retail marketing services company, Canada's largest printer, and the Canadian leader in French\-language educational publishing. Driven by the vision of a more informed, educated and prosperous society, TC Transcontinental propels its clients' success across the retail, education, book and information industries. With agility, creativity and boldness, we design and deliver innovative, high\-value products and services.  

We are looking for a Strategic Account Director who will be responsible for the strategic leadership, growth and long\-term health of a portfolio of TC Transcontinental Core Accounts representing more than $100 million in annual revenue.  

This position is currently open and reflects a new position created to support organizational growth.  

The salary range for this position is $125,000 to $135,000 per year, commensurate with experience, education, and internal equity. This range is provided to ensure clarity and promote equitable access to employment opportunities.
Responsibilities:
**When your actions lead to success:*** Lead the **strategy, growth and long\-term success** of key strategic accounts representing significant annual revenue.
* Develop and execute strategic account plans aligned with customer priorities and business objectives.
* Build trusted relationships with **senior and executive\-level customer stakeholders**.
* Identify and advance opportunities to **grow revenue, expand relationships and increase share of customer spend**.
* Connect capabilities across the organization to develop **integrated, enterprise\-level customer solutions**.
* Lead strategic customer discussions, business reviews and long\-term planning sessions.
* Support major **contract renewals, commercial strategies and customer negotiations**.
* Align cross\-functional teams around key opportunities, priorities and risks while ensuring accountability for strategic initiatives.


Qualifications:
**When your expertise drives us:*** 10\+ years of experience in **strategic account management, enterprise sales or business development**.
* Proven success managing **large, complex strategic accounts** and driving sustainable revenue growth.
* Strong ability to build credibility and relationships with **senior and executive\-level stakeholders**.
* Demonstrated success in **consultative and solution\-based selling**.Experience with **complex negotiations, contract renewals and commercial strategy**.
* Strong **business and financial acumen** with the ability to develop compelling business cases.
* Proven ability to **lead and influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority**.
* Exceptional communication, presentation and relationship\-management skills.
* Experience in **retail, marketing services, technology, content, media or manufacturing** is an asset.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

**When benefits really help you live better:**
We offer a comprehensive and flexible benefits package designed to support your well\-being and help you thrive—at work and at home. Our offerings include:* Competitive compensation with performance\-based incentives and retirement savings plans with company match
* Customizable group benefits including health, dental, life, disability, and travel insurance
* Paid time off
* Employee perks such as discounts on insurance, wireless plans, travel, and more
* Career development opportunities
* A dynamic, inclusive work environment where your voice matters and your growth is supported

**EEO**  

TC Transcontinental is committed to fair, transparent, and equitable hiring practices. We disclose that no artificial intelligence (AI) tools or automated decision\-making systems are used in our recruitment or selection process.  

TC Transcontinental is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the jurisdictions where we operate.  

We are also committed to providing an inclusive and barrier\-free recruitment and work environment—promoting dignity, independence, integration, and equal opportunity for all, including persons with disabilities. Accommodations, including alternative formats, will be made available for all parts of the recruitment and selection process. For more information or to request an accommodation please contact talent@tc.tc.  

Send us your application. Create something with TC Transcontinental.
